status: approved by the maintainer on 2026-11-17, with 10 percent added to each proposed budget
rule: A max budget is the worst of 5 runs plus a margin. The margin is 25 percent of the worst value or the floor of the metric's unit in marginFloors, whichever is larger. A min budget is the worst of 5 runs minus 25 percent. A value in microseconds is rounded up to the next 5 microsecond clock step. Other max budgets are rounded up to an integer.

marginFloors.note: A unit that is not in this list has no floor. The ms floor is two times the range of outage.drainMs in the 5 runs (12 ms). The us floor is two clock steps. The bytes/10k floor is the band of the 15 heap reads in the fit (952 to 988 bytes).

machine.workingTree: Changes that were not committed. src/ had no changes.

outage.recoveryToDrainMs.note: Not from the rule. The retry timer is random up to delivery.retryMaxDelayMs, which the workload sets to 1000 ms. The proposed budget is 1000 ms plus the proposed outage.drainMs budget, 1067 ms. The approved budget adds 10 percent.
